title: PyTorch Model Predict
text: Predict responses using pretrained Python PyTorch model, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Load command} sets Load command for Python model; {Path to model file or state_dict file} sets the name or path of Python PyTorch model file or state_dict file, {Model class name and optional arguments (if using load_state_dict)} sets the model class name and optional arguments character, {Execution device}, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Inputs} sets the input port properties table, {Outputs} sets the output port properties table, {Path to Python file defining preprocess()} sets the name or path of Python preprocessing function file character and {Path to Python file defining postprocess()} sets the name or path of Python postprocessing function file character. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Load command
params.values: Load command for Python model torch.load() (default) | torch.jit.load() | load_state_dict()

params.name: Path to model file or state_dict file
params.values: Name or path of Python PyTorch model file or state_dict file untitled (default) | character vector

params.name: Model class name and optional arguments (if using load_state_dict)
params.values: Model class name and optional arguments character vector

params.name: Execution device
params.values: Execution device for Python model cpu (default) | cuda | device name

params.name: Sample time (–1 for inherited)
params.values: Option to specify sample time –1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Path to Python file defining preprocess()
params.values: Name or path of Python preprocessing function file character vector

params.name: Path to Python file defining postprocess()
params.values: Name or path of Python postprocessing function file character vector
